name: Silence: Zero Amplitude
description: Start from silence (amplitude = 0). Gradually increase amplitude to see the wave pattern appear. Demonstrates that amplitude controls loudness: zero amplitude = no sound.

successCriteria.description: Discover that amplitude = 0 produces no visible wave pattern
Increase amplitude to see the wave pattern appear and grow stronger

hints.message: Amplitude = 0 means silence. Slowly drag the Amplitude slider to the right to 'turn up' the volume.
The gray-scale arcs become more visible (darker darks, lighter lights) as amplitude increases.
